text:
maria: onboarding a Dedicated customer — their k8s cluster fails TLS with CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED when going through corporate proxy + custom CA. local sample works. python async SDK (aiohttp)
aj: are you passing base_url or using REDWOOD_BASE_URL? any proxy envs?
maria: passing base_url. snippet:
```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
async def main():
  c = AsyncClient(base_url='https://dedicated.example.com', api_key='redacted', proxy='http://10.0.0.1:3128', ca_bundle='/etc/ssl/redwood-ca.pem')
  await c.generate('hello')
```
fails during handshake even with SSL_CERT_FILE set.
samir: likely aiohttp isn't reading SSL_CERT_FILE; create ssl.SSLContext and pass via connector_args, e.g. ssl.create_default_context(cafile='/etc/ssl/redwood-ca.pem'). Also ensure token refresh uses same ssl ctx — we saw retry 401s when refresh used default context.
maria: tried ssl ctx + forcing HTTP/1.1 and that fixed generation. mypy complains about connector_args typing.
olivia: UX asks: add explicit truststore_path param and type connector_args as Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] so mypy is happy. also document updating OS truststore in sample Dockerfile/k8s initContainer.
aj: filing GH issue with repro and labels: py-sdk, devex, security.
devx-bot: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/issues/4735 — "py-sdk: add truststore_path + ensure ssl context reuse on refresh retries" (assign: aj) :rocket:
